intro.text: A monastery cut into a ravine in western Shinovar.

description.text: Only a few keepers' homes surround it. A high skylight illuminates the grand hall, whose floor bears a mural of Shush.

items.text: Szeth found the Honorbearer hiding among illusions of Shush. He defeated him and recovered the Lightweaver Honorblade, freeing the acolytes concealed by the illusions.
The Truthwatcher Honorbearer then attacked Szeth among the released acolytes. Kaladin stopped her, and the party continued toward the remaining monasteries.
